name: polls
description: Turns your forms into polls, surveys and scored quizzes, with live results, per-question breakdowns and CSV export.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: The forms to count. Each one becomes a poll, a survey or a scored quiz.

form_slug.title: Form slug
form_slug.description: The slug of an existing form.

show_results.title: Show results
show_results.description: Whether visitors may see the results page.

closes_at.title: Closes at (UTC), e.g. 2027-01-01 18:00
closes_at.description: Answers after this time are not counted. Write a date, or a date and time such as 2027-01-01 18:00. A value without a time zone is read as UTC. Leave empty to count forever.

answer_key.title: Answer key
answer_key.description: Quiz only: the correct value of each question. For a checkbox question list several values separated by commas.

email_score.title: Email the score
email_score.description: Quiz only: email the score to the address the visitor gave.
